items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Lars in their response; Lars is only mentioned by the interviewer as a potential drummer in Lee Collins' band, which the interviewee does not confirm or deny having a personal connection with.

ctx.x: Oh man, I can't remember. That had been so long. I played with all of them. Joe Rochelle was on piano, though. I remember that. All of them people was dead, not what I'm talking about. Yeah, he was dead. Who played band you? Who played band you? I think Sills. Sills. He named Sills. He played on the record? Yeah. He named Sills. He was some dude. Daniel Barker, one of them.

Didn't you tell me something about them having different drummers in that band, Lars? Did you change, did this fellow Martin play with the band all the time? Yeah. The drum player. Martin? Didn't you have different drum players in the band? You changed drums? My first band? No, in Lee Collins' band. Did they have the same drum player all the time?

No, no, no. My drum player, he died, he died, Roy Evans. Oh yeah? Yeah. Well, he must be Lee Collins first? He was good boy. He was really good. He was really good. He just died. No, not Lee. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little while ago.
